text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking near the training 
track—

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Haah, haah— ...Pheeew~~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmh~~, it's been a while since I've worked 
up such a good sweat♪

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that? That top speed! So 
cool, right~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should try copying her form. 
Running like that must feel so good...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If that's the case, want to run 
together? If you want a reference, seeing 
it up close is best, after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-Is that really okay?! It would be 
an honor... Yes, please!!!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no need to be so formal. Looking 
forward to running with you all.

text_block_list.name: Spectating Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: KYAAAA!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, every time I caught sight 
of her—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san! Thank you so much for giving 
me advice the other day!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Totally no prob! A-OK! So, did 
Gentildonna-chan like it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she praised it, saying it suited her 
palate! I'm so glad I asked you, 
Maruzen-san♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're so mature, Maruzen-san... You know 
about so many wonderful things.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! I'm happy to help anytime, so feel 
free to lean on me whenever you need♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! That was simply 
wonderful, totally groovy-good!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It is entirely the 
fruit of your guidance, Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've always admired your dancing, so 
graceful all the way to your fingertips♪ 
Thank you so much for teaching me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, jeez~~ Being praised like that tickles 
a bit, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky is adored by her juniors and 
treated as a role model. Her dependable, 
big-sister presence surely provides 
everyone with a sense of security.
choice_data_list:
(As an instructor, I should take 
notes...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while thinking about such things, 
the taxi I reserved failed to show up, and 
I was anxiously glaring at my watch when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech— Slam!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haaai! In a bit of a pinch by any chance?
choice_data_list: The taxi I called still hasn't arrived...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, what a bummer-rama~! It's for work, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I can give you a lift! I 
just happen to be driving Tacchan today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She pointed toward a bright red supercar 
parked nearby, which clearly belonged to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With Tacchan here, we'll fly to wherever 
you need in a jiffy! Come on, don't be 
shy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be you feel you can't rely on 
a horse girl as their mentor?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel, but try looking 
at it from another angle.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Helping you out is practically the same as 
helping out the horse girl you're 
training, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Helping you out is practically the same as 
helping out the horse girl you're 
training, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I want to lend a hand in her growth. So, 
please? Just for today, let me help you 
out.
choice_data_list: Now I see why everyone looks up to you...
Now I see why everyone looks up to you...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wicked cool, right? So... what'll it 
be, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky was right. Being late just to 
save face would only cause trouble for my 
trainee.
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll take you up on that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, leave it to big sis! Here we—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's-a go on a wonderful drive♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a message arrived from the taxi 
I was waiting for, saying they had been 
stuck in traffic but were arriving 
shortly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Well, that's great! What a relief!
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry, after you were kind enough to 
offer!

I'm sorry, after you were kind enough to 
offer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, we help each other 
out in times of need. Let's save our drive 
date for next time♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ciao♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but gaze in admiration at 
her dashing back as she walked away.
